name: fynns-ui-consume
title: Install @fynns/ui via zero-token sibling file: (LLM contract)
description: Machine-readable API for agents: link @fynn7/ui-design-core from public sibling ../fynns_ui_design_core (file:) and wire Vite/tsconfig alias @fynns/ui. No NODE_AUTH_TOKEN for day-to-day. Optional GitHub Packages is publishers-only. Do not use git submodule. Short user prompts still require reading this contract before UI work.
rules: On any short prompt involving @fynns/ui / fynns UI / Collapsible (etc.), read llm/CONSUME.md before writing app code.
Paste llm/consumer-cursor-rule.mdc into the consumer .cursor/rules/ (see llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md) so agents obey without opening AGENTS.

Default destination app chrome: DestinationAppShell (sandbox Layout templates #layouts-demo-shell) unless the user specifies another template. Destinations are binary: open labeled resizable drawer or fully hidden — never densify DestinationAppShell / ClippedNav crowding to an icon-only NavigationRail. Never greenfield desktop from standalone NavigationRail; intentional phone / icon-column roots may mount NavigationRail alone (Layouts #layouts-demo-navigation-rail).

ClippedNavShell (slot API): navMode must match nav children (drawer→NavigationDrawer, rail→NavigationRail). Never leave a labeled drawer in a rail-width track. Prefer DestinationAppShell so agents need not hand-sync. nav = destinations only — never wiki/page body/forms/Chat/Preview in the nav track (those go in children/main or aside/EndAside). "Clipped" = M3 chrome topology under a full-bleed TopAppBar — not text clipping; diagnose data-nav / track width / which slot holds odd copy before restyling .fynns-*. NavigationDrawer: Item/Group/Headline use --fynns-navdrawer-section-gap (4dp); SearchBar/tools/SyncSideFilter ToggleGroup/--toolbar-end ↔ peers & destinations use --fynns-navdrawer-search-gap (8dp, aliases control-stack-gap). Never wrap destinations in .fynns-unit-stack. See llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md squashed drawer + wrong shell slot + destination gap.

Inspector / Surface labeled rows: use ControlStack + ControlRow (label | controls); sibling controls in .fynns-control-cluster; supporting/timestamp copy via ControlBlock description. Core docks the hint in the label column and vertically centers ToggleGroup on name+hint — never a full-bleed next row (empty band to the right of the timestamp on a narrow window). Do not put the timestamp in ControlRow label or as a Surface sibling. Never hand-rolled flex. Padded Surface is a form host (same as Card body). Live: sandbox #rhythm + #form-recipe. See llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md ad-hoc Surface / inspector row chaos.

Content density: path/link/bookmark catalogs = one List of ListItems (headline + supportingText path + trailing ghost md IconButtons). Never one padded Surface/Card per entry; never put row actions under the text or as a filled danger disk. Interactive ListItem trailing is outside the row button. Table/list pager: `.fynns-pagination-bar` (M3/MUI single footer row — Select + range start, nowrap Pagination end) — never vertical Select-then-pager stack, never grow Select to crush page discs. Live: sandbox #list + #pagination. See AGENTS.md Content density + llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md Pagination crushed or stacked off-spec.

WYSIWYG / surface sync: sandbox Globals/Preview/Layouts resting look is the consumer default; never restyle .fynns-* in the app. SANDBOX_DEFAULT_OVERRIDES must stay empty. Core: never sandbox-only drop of an exported symbol — atomic delete (unexport+source+demo+BREAKING_PURGE). npm run check:wysiwyg.

Loading placement: pane cold-start = BusyRegion fill in a height-resolved host (FillColumn children / shell main). Do not use EmptyState + CircularProgress as a loading shell. Full-app block = BusyScrim. Inline = CircularProgress sm. See AGENTS.md Loading placement.

Day-to-day consume: public sibling ../fynns_ui_design_core + file: dependency @fynn7/ui-design-core + Vite source alias @fynns/ui → node_modules/@fynn7/ui-design-core/src/index.ts. NO NODE_AUTH_TOKEN / gh packages login required.

DO add @fynn7/ui-design-core to package.json dependencies (file: sibling). Do NOT depend on @fynns/ui or @fynns/ui-design-core as registry package names. Do NOT use git submodule for day-to-day consume. Do NOT commit _authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN} in consumer .npmrc.
Do NOT require GitHub Packages for consumer onboarding — Packages npm always needs a token even when public. Optional --packages path is publishers/bump only.
Keep resolve.dedupe [react, react-dom] so package source shares the app React instance.
Do not modify files inside node_modules/@fynn7/ui-design-core for consumer features (refresh sibling / bump instead). There is no consume:sync / consume:watch worktree mirror.

Before any @fynns/ui UI work: ensure sibling + file: link (scripts/ensure-sibling-ui-core.mjs) and consume --check (dependency + alias; fails if legacy submodule tree remains). Re-paste consumer-cursor-rule.mdc when the treaty updates (installer does not overwrite).

On E401: leftover Packages .npmrc / empty NODE_AUTH_TOKEN — switch to sibling file: + safe @fynn7→registry.npmjs.org .npmrc. See llm/CONSUME.md + llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md zero-token sibling consume + llm/consumer-cursor-rule.mdc 安装与 API.
Consumer tsconfig compilerOptions.target and lib must be ES2022 or later (tsc follows @fynns/ui into design-system sources; ES2020 fails on APIs such as String.replaceAll).

Update notices: consume:install wires fynns-ui:check-update into predev/prebuild/prepreview/postinstall so npm run dev/build reminds when GitHub Packages has a newer @fynn7/ui-design-core. Silence with FYNNS_UI_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1. Monorepo: bump in the app package that owns predev (e.g. apps/web), not only at the git root — nested node_modules wins for Vite.
Do not import purged symbols (toast/Toaster/Popover/UnitStack/…). Dialog/Drawer/Textarea/Tabs/InlineAlert are restored — see llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md. Use snackbar + SnackbarHost for transient feedback.
App entry must createRoot and render App (CSS-only main.tsx is a fail).
Never hand-roll Collapsible chrome or use @radix-ui/* / sonner.

Collapsible/Card chrome: default card; when nesting a surface-owning child (CodeBlock/Surface/canvas/BusyRegion) pass chrome="plain" — body pad = --fynns-layout-content-inset, column gap = --fynns-layout-nest-gap; plain ≠ flush — never cancel nest-gap with negative margins or zero body pad. Outside those shells use .fynns-nest.

CodeBlock chrome (strict): titled default requires non-empty label (filename); omit/empty label throws. No title → variant="plain" (frame + float copy). Never label="" to fake a headless titled block.

CodeBlock language (strict): label is chrome only — not a language detector. Always pass language (or highlightProfile / registered id) matching the source (e.g. label="system-prompt.xml" + language="xml"). Omitted/unknown language → plain mono. Built-ins: ts/js/py/cpp/css/json/xml/html/bash/…. Fill editable hosts → autoGrow={false}. Authority: llm/AGENT_INTERFACES.md.

API-only: pass props/children/labels to @fynns/ui; never wrap keep-set primitives in consumer restyles or local .fynns-* overrides. If the keep-set cannot meet the ask, tell the user explicitly to implement in fynns_ui_design_core first. Chat containers must stay ≥ --fynns-radius-22 unless the user explicitly asks squarer (see AGENTS.md Hard rules).

ChatMessage Markdown (prefer core): use ChatMessage markdown={md} or <ChatMarkdown source={md} /> (L2 GFM subset). When markdown is set it wins over children. Never pass raw Markdown strings as bare children. Authority: AGENTS.md Parity note (markdown/GFM) + consumer-cursor-rule.mdc.
If build uses tsc, add vite-env.d.ts with /// <reference types="vite/client" /> so CSS imports from @fynns/ui typecheck.
For preview/playground pages, mirror examples/sandbox/src/pages/*PreviewCanvas.tsx and skim AGENTS.md.
Shells (ClippedNavShell), token inspectors, Globals-style catalogs, and live draft GUIs: read llm/PERF.md before coding (no observer↔probe loops, no tip forests, lazy-mount dense sections).

ensureSibling.description: Clone/link public sibling ../fynns_ui_design_core and optionally npm install file: (zero-token).

install.description: Default --sibling: safe .npmrc + wire Vite/tsconfig @fynns/ui (no token). Opt-in --packages for GitHub Packages (token).

check.description: Validate dependency + .npmrc + @fynns/ui alias + no leftover submodule tree (exit 1 if incomplete).

wireOnly.description: Dependency already present; only patch .npmrc / Vite / tsconfig / update-check hooks.

checkUpdate.description: Non-blocking notice when a newer @fynn7/ui-design-core is on GitHub Packages. Wired into consumer predev/prebuild/prepreview/postinstall.

env.FYNNS_UI_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK: Set to 1 to silence registry notices (CI).

publish.description: Optional: bump + publish to GitHub Packages for Packages workflows. Day-to-day consumers refresh sibling file:. See docs/package-propagation.md.

successCriteria: vite.config.* has resolve.alias["@fynns/ui"] pointing at that entry
vite resolve.dedupe includes react and react-dom
tsconfig paths map @fynns/ui to the same entry (when a tsconfig exists)
tsconfig target/lib are ES2022+ when the consumer runs tsc against @fynns/ui
no packages/fynns_ui_design_core (or gui/…) git submodule left as the alias target
clone → npm install → npm run dev needs no NODE_AUTH_TOKEN / gh packages login
import { Collapsible } from "@fynns/ui" typechecks / builds in the consumer
no imports of purged symbols listed in llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md
